description:
[Market] Multi-market arbitrage loops (buy here, sell there, repeat). The loops on rust.wiki/skins/chains: buy a skin on market X, sell it on Y, use that balance to buy something
to sell back on X (up to four markets), where the after-fee rates multiply to more than 1. Each loop: `markets`
in order, `legs` (the skin bought on each market and what it fetches on the next), `factor`, `cap` (the most
starting money it carries at these top-of-book prices, cents - an estimate) and `profit` at that size (cents).
Prices move: check every leg before trading. Rebuilt with every marketplace poll. Prices move: tell the user to check every leg before trading.

hops.description: Only loops with exactly this many legs (2-4).

min_profit.description: Only loops making at least this many US DOLLARS at their capacity.

mode.description: `instant` = every sell leg goes into a buy order or buyback now; `all` also allows listing and waiting (slower, less certain).

start.description: Only loops through this marketplace, rotated to start there.
